translations.web: Then Yahweh’s Spirit will come mightily on you, and you will prophesy with them, and will be turned into another man.
translations.bsb: Then the Spirit of the LORD will rush upon you, and you will prophesy with them; and you will be transformed into a different person.
translations.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.
translations.asv: and the Spirit of Jehovah will come mightily upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.
